notes.title: Complete Graphical Overhaul for Silvern Moonrise 🌕
notes.content: [h1]What's New?[/h1][p]The development for Silvern Moonrise is going strong! This latest batch of updates contains custom shaders, polished spritework, and continual upgrades to the player UI/UX to create a retro, CRT vibe. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610169/dbe2243e83498eb1241e12862b26d2204e5e85b7.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Enemies and Abilities[/h1][list][*][p]Added 4 new Demons, along with over 15 alternate versions of Demons all available for capture. Bring the best Servants that round out your party![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added over 25 new abilities and sprites - each typing will feature a wide range of base abilities that can be further Enchanted into unique, powerful abilities[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610169/7780503657e2bd64e721c4f56f8a6249e69bd162.png"][/img][/h1][h1]New Ways to Enchant[/h1][list][*][p]Players can now see the numerical changes to abilities when Enchanting[/p][/*][*][p]Over 35 new Enchant effects have to added, including Faction specific effects like Devil's Luck, which allows your Demons and Hunters to specialize in high risk, high reward LUK-based combat[/p][/*][/list][h2]More Exciting News to Come, Wishlist Now![/h2][list][*][p]The Demo for Silvern Moonrise is actively being developed and version 1.0 is ready soon, with replayable levels, 2 Biomes to explore, and over 10 different capturable Demons.[/p][/*][*][p]The beta version has already been approved by Steam, so expect exciting news soon! 😉[/p][/*][/list]
